title: Codex for (almost) everything
summary: The updated Codex app for macOS and Windows adds computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and plugins to accelerate developer workflows.
body: The updated Codex app for macOS and Windows adds computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and plugins to accelerate developer workflows.
summaryZh: Codex桌面端应用迎来重大更新，新增了计算机使用（Computer Use）、应用内浏览、图像生成及记忆功能。这些更新使Codex能够更深入地介入开发者的工作流，通过插件扩展能力，显著提升了自动化处理复杂任务的效率。

aiReview.reasonZh: Codex桌面端更新引入了计算机使用和插件功能，标志着其向具备自主操作能力的AI Agent演进。
